caption: The video captures a stainless-steel bowl held tilted above a black non-stick frying pan resting on a gas burner of a steel stovetop, with a wooden counter edge at the left. Inside the pan sits a single fried egg, its bright-orange yolk ringed by pale, irregular white. A thin, clear stream of liquid pours continuously from the bowl's rim onto the egg throughout the clip. As the sequence progresses, the bowl steadily descends and tilts forward, its body moving from a high position down until the rim hovers just above the egg. The point where the stream lands shifts from the upper-left of the white toward the top edge near the yolk. The egg's outline stays largely the same size while the yolk remains near the center. The pan, burner, and background keep their positions, indicating the motion belongs to the bowl and the falling stream.
